Fig. 3 | Oxetane ring formation. Oxetane is formed from either oxidative 
rearrangement by CYP725A55 (TOT) or hydroxylation/epoxidation by T5αOH/
epoxidase. The oxetane ring formation mechanism of TOT was proposed on 
the basis of density functional theory calculations; the reaction mechanism of 
CYP725A55 was illustrated by deuterium and 18O-labelling experiments.
